title_en: Return to a Zombie-Infested Riverdale In This Exclusive Preview of Oni Press' Afterlife With Archie: Mausoleum Edition Hardcover
summary_en: One of the best modern Archie stories ever published is rising from the grave, as Oni Press reveals the Afterlife With Archie: Mausoleum Edition hardcover.
body_en:
Afterlife With Archie is undoubtedly one of the most successful revamps of the decades-old Archie franchise. Who doesn't love seeing this wholesome teen thrust into a world of zombies and brooding horror? Even as Oni Press kicks off a new era for the franchise, they're also celebrating this particular classic by teasing a new "Afterlife With Archie: Mausoleum Edition" hardcover set.
With the Kickstarter campaign for Afterlife With Archie: Mausoleum Edition Vol. 1 now live, IGN can exclusively reveal some of the artwork featured in this set. Check out the slideshow gallery below to see the exclusive posters and glow-in-the-dark cover art:
Afterlife With Archie was written by Roberto Aguirre-Sacasa and illustrated by Francesco Francavilla. The series originally debuted in 2013 to rave reviews ( including on IGN ). Here's the official description of the new hardcover:
The Kickstarter campaign for Afterlife With Archie: Mausoleum Edition Vol. 1 features plenty of optional bonuses, including signed copies from Aguirre-Sacasa and Farncavilla, the aforementioned posters, T-shirts, enamel pins, and reprints of the individual issues.
For more, check out IGN's reviews of all three of Oni Press' rebooted Archie comics .
